marketUsedForTrading.question: Will I think all AI hell broke loose in 2026?
marketUsedForTrading.creator: EliezerYudkowsky

keyFindings: Full buy/sell cycle works with zero fees and negligible slippage on small bets
9 tools implemented covering search, market detail, user info, betting, selling, positions, liquidity, and mana transfer
No preview/cost estimation tool — only failure. Agent must calculate expected cost from pool state (CPMM formula is deterministic)
sell_shares requires explicit 'outcome' param despite schema listing it as optional — minor API bug
Error messages are structured JSON-RPC but sometimes vague ('Forbidden' for insufficient balance instead of descriptive message)
Supports limit orders via limitProb parameter on place_bet, and cancel_bet for limit order cancellation
Server recovers cleanly after errors with no state corruption

agentReadiness.verdict: Ready for AI trading agent use. All core operations (discover, bet, sell, monitor) work reliably. The missing cost preview is a minor gap — an agent can compute expected cost from the CPMM pool state returned by get_market.
